newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kian Ann offers 30 million shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Kian Ann offers 30 million shares in IPO.

text.p: Kian Ann Engineering Ltd said on Monday it was offering 30 million new shares at Singapore $0.60 each in its initial public offer (IPO).
The company said in a statement that six million shares out of the 30 million would be placed out and the balance would be offered to the pubic.
Kian Ann, which will be listed on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore, is a distributor of heavy equipment and diesel engine parts.
The offer will raise net proceeds of about S$16.5 million to be used to reduce bank borrowings, to increase its range of stock and for working capital.
The shares are offered at a historical price earnings ratio of 10.8 times.
For the year ended June 30 1996, the company made net profit of S$4.99 million on a turnover of $63.14 million.
The offer closes on November 7 and trading will start on November 12.
